summary: Iteration 13 — Guest AI (homepage section + floating widget) and Buddy support-answer regressions. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases passing (guest config no-auth, empty/>500 char validation, SSE streaming with done event, db.ai_guest_asks persistence with ip+question+reply, refund-policy answer sourced from CMS (no 'contact support' punt), event links resolving to real published events, /ai/concierge and /ai/config still require auth, member concierge stream + history smoke). Frontend: guest concierge section renders with input/send/3 suggestion chips; floating widget visible on /, /events, /cities, /city/dubai, /passes; guest one-shot streams a reply, then locks with Join CTA; lock is shared with the homepage section AND survives reload; clearing localStorage bud_guest_ai_qa resets it. Member flow: widget shown while logged in, hidden on /ai, 'Open the full Buddy AI page' link present, bi-directional session sharing verified — a message sent through the widget appears on /ai and vice-versa. No horizontal overflow at 1920px or 390px on /, /events, /dashboard.

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' logged repeatedly on every page. Not introduced by iteration 13 but worth cleaning.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2972 lines — should be split into modules (auth, events, ai, admin, etc.). Not blocking iteration 13.
ai_help_block cache has no lock — under simultaneous requests you may run the CMS fetch multiple times. Low impact (idempotent), but a small asyncio.Lock would be cleaner.
AiChatWidget: when the widget config load fails silently we get no ai-widget-suggestion-N chips but the intro is still rendered — user experience acceptable but consider a retry.
seed_data_creation: None. Test file cleans up its ai_messages (session_id TEST_iter13_*) and ai_guest_asks rows it created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Buddy AI feature is production-grade. Backend regression file lives at backend/tests/test_iteration13_guest_ai.py — reuse. LLM calls are billable and the per-IP guest cap is 25/24h shared with the backend; keep prompts short ('one line only') if you re-run. Guest lock is localStorage-only (bud_guest_ai_qa); the session for member widget/page is bud_ai_session. Widget is hidden on /ai by AiChatWidget's useLocation check. Existing hydration warning about <span> inside <option> is pre-existing (present in select filters on /events login etc.).
